# Guarded campaign plan — integration gates remain

**AI disclosure:** Generated by AI. Not executed; not hardware authorization.
Parent [driver #42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42) stays open.

Eight workloads: `{B,E} × {VA,Gst} × {observer copy off,on}`. The actual native lifetime
APIs and experimental bounded copy path now exist; see [integration](integration/README.md).
The additive [Gst call site](gst-callsite/README.md) and
[FFmpeg/VA call site](va-callsite/README.md) now wire their production output
boundaries, with offline tests and explicit internal arming. Selected-writer scheduling is
merged. A [campaign controller](campaign/README.md) now plans and reviews these
eight workloads against the shared budgets and distinct Gst/VA call-site limits,
and refuses to execute them. Gst `system_frame_number`s, VA output ordinals and
parameter-set input windows are separate coordinates. The planner enforces the
VA client's `threads=1`, one-application-owner, finish-before-close and fatal
quarantine contracts and emits deterministic per-workload adapter inputs. The
VA call site now has a real decoder-worker result path and strict normalized
collector; its exclusive report destination and whole-process-success rule are
part of the emitted contract. The Gst side now has the equivalent real runner.
The [same-run supervisor](same-run/README.md) can execute one later admitted
workload and binds either client result through its actual queue/V4L2 lifetime to
paired sealed kernel evidence. There is still no executable eight-workload
campaign command. Remaining: exact loaded build/client/tool/corpus evidence, an
approved deployment manifest, proven live target eligibility (including Gst's
pre-publication allocation limit), controller-level workload admission and the
authorized guarded campaign. Re-review this plan against that exact head. The manifest verifier alone covers the
observer object, kernel, AVD and modular vb2 components; it does not cover the
full clients.

Use a fresh run UUID/root, the portable exclusive guard, fixed journal boundary,
foreign-client check and healthy idle start. Off and on both pause/drain, retain
allocation and surface, map and preallocate; only selected compressed/MV copies differ.
Keep reference, completion and command records from that same run with zero lost records.
Initial targets: three selected E writers and one B control per client (eight
unique targets). Each target is observed in paired copy-off/on workloads: sixteen
selected observations, but only the eight copy-on observations retain copied
bytes. Select their actual identities from same-run records, not assumed
POC/index mappings.

Budgets: 184320 bytes/copied snapshot, eight copied snapshots/1474560 bytes total,
at most 368128 bytes per retained mapping, 20ms copy, 2s drain, proposed 120s/run
and 20min campaign external deadlines. A deadline rejects a late copy; it cannot
interrupt a stuck memory access. External guard/watchdog and healthy restoration
rules still apply.

Compare every decoded output frame and selected same-run command/reference
projection. Require B exact/E known-wrong outputs unchanged across off/on, no new
error, timeout, foreign client, lost record or identity drift, and final healthy idle.
Stop on a discrepancy; retain failed evidence, do not replay automatically. A matching
output bounds measured disturbance; it does not prove zero disturbance.

Raw bytes stay private pending interpretation. Publish only reviewed normalized
metadata/range hashes. Differing opaque bytes can include padding or unobserved
state; they do not establish firmware responsibility. Equal sampled bytes do not
rule out omitted ranges or later accesses. No decoder lease, module change or install
is authorized by this implementation leaf.


## Readiness and execution record

The following is a plan, not a run result or an installer recipe.

1. Archive the exact integration commit, existing observer patch hashes, compiler/
   linker/Meson/Ninja identities, kernel configuration and build/source attestations.
   Hash the actual FFmpeg or Gst executable, all relevant loaded libraries/plugins,
   decoder module and vb2 components. Verify loaded build IDs against the reviewed
   artifacts; do not synthesize historical evidence or approve a manifest merely
   because it matches the current machine. Built-in vb2 remains unsupported here.
2. Review the VA callback location against the API lock order and the Gst callback
   location before publication. Identify the exact successful writer and all later
   readers from native records. Join kernel command/reference records through the
   same run/context/allocation/writer identity; frame, POC, fd and capture index alone
   cannot authorize or identify a snapshot. For VA, use distinct zero-based output
   ordinals on a fresh `threads=1` decoder and keep send/receive/finish/close on one
   application owner; do not pass Gst `system_frame_number` selections through as
   VA ordinals. Missing/lost/ambiguous joins block entry.
   Give each VA workload a new exclusive `va_observer_report` path, accept only
   the fixed normalized schema after the whole FFmpeg process exits zero, and
   reject a pre-existing path or any collector mismatch.
3. Verify the original B/E corpus lock and every input hash. Create a fresh root for
   each of the eight workloads, retaining exact argv/environment, monotonic/journal
   boundaries, tool identities and zero-loss trace accounting. Repeat the same
   selected writers in paired off/on runs using each run's own generations.
4. Allocate and initialize the same pool before each native begin. Off/on both retain,
   pause/drain, verify provenance, map/unmap and end; only the two bounded memcpy
   operations differ. Carry the original begin deadline through snapshot. Failed
   mapping cleanup retains the lease; report it to the outer watchdog and stop.
   Hash only valid slots after successful end. Never publish raw bytes automatically.
5. Compare every decoded frame against the same locked references, plus the selected
   normalized command/reference projections and final health. Record full denominators,
   rejections, partial runs and lost records. Do not turn an aborted pair into a pass.
   Preserve failed evidence and stop without automatic re-open, module reload or replay.

The exclusive guard, device health preflight/final idle check and applicable system
consent remain separate requirements. This plan neither obtains a hardware lease nor
changes the project's supported profiles, pass counts or parent correction gates.
